competences.description: Attacks the enemy 2 times and weakens the enemy's Defense and inflicts continuous damage for 2 turns with a 15% chance with each attack. The Attack Power increases according to Defense.

effets.description: The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.
The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)

competences.description: Attacks all enemies dealing damage proportionate to your Defense and inflicts Continuous Damage for 3 turns with a 50% chance. The damage of this skill will increase by 30% for each harmful effect on the enemy.

effets.description: The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)
Increases damage per debuff on the target

competences.description: Increase the enemy's chances of landing a Glancing Hit by 30% and counterattacks with a 15% chance. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: The chance of landing a glancing hit will be increased by 50%. Glancing Hits will decrease the damage by 30% and if the attacker has attribute disadvantage, damage will be decreased additionally by 16%.
When attacked, the target will counterattack to inflict 75% of the Attack Power as damage.
